scope: Fixed-model leave-one-underlying-week-out development diagnostics. No hyperparameter search, promotion, causal policy ranking or new worlds. Same underlying seeds never cross a training/test fold.
bookingComparatorLimitation: Existing portfolio booking prior predicts booking within120minutes from award, whereas these interventions measure120minutes from posting. The full action-conditioned heuristic was not reconstructed; the comparable-heuristic gate is unmet.
costModelLimitation: First-gig payments and incompletely allocated order ledgers are not full continuation cost. No cost-prediction validation or capacity-value inference is claimed.
decision: Keep the retained policy and simple baselines unless every predeclared model gate passes. Passing only permits a separately frozen structural experiment; it is not validation of policy economics.
